landing.heroTitle: Celebrate together, no matter the distance
landing.heroSubtitle: Make a list for your wedding, new baby, or birthday. Share it with family in Haiti and abroad, so everyone knows what you would love.
landing.featureRegistryDesc: Create gift lists for baby showers, weddings, or birthdays. Add photos, links, or local products.
landing.featureShareDesc: Share your registry on WhatsApp, Facebook, and other social networks with one click.
landing.featureLocalDesc: Support Haitian businesses. Add local products to your registry.
landing.featurePaymentDesc: Accept gifts via MonCash, Natcash, credit card, and PayPal.
landing.step1Desc: Choose an occasion and add your gifts, photos, and details. You decide what goes on the list.
landing.step2Desc: Send your registry to family and friends on WhatsApp, by message, or by email.
landing.step3Desc: Guests choose from your list. Available checkout methods and the final price are shown before payment.
landing.eyebrow: The gift registry for Haiti and its diaspora

landing.connectionIntro: One shared list, wherever your family calls home.

landing.babyDesc: The little essentials for your newest arrival.
landing.weddingDesc: Your first chapter together. A list that feels like both of you.
landing.birthdayDesc: Less guessing. More of what you really want.
landing.howEyebrow: From wish list to shared moment
landing.howTitle: Make it yours in three steps
landing.localDesc: Explore products listed by Haitian businesses and add available favorites to your registry.
